_readme.purpose: Four templates for the OP diagnostic recovery journey. Submit to Meta before activating OP_DIAGNOSTIC_RECOVERY.
_readme.category: MARKETING — these carry a discount, so they are marketing whatever we call them internally. Submitting as UTILITY would be rejected, and worse, could get the number's quality rating marked down.
_readme.safety: No test name, no finding, no result anywhere in any body. Phones are shared between family members and these say only that diagnostics are available — a message safe for a son to read on his mother's phone.
_readme.buttons: QUICK_REPLY buttons carry a payload the engine matches on. The payload is what routes; the label is only what the patient sees.
_readme.how_to_submit: WhatsApp Manager > Account tools > Message templates > Create, or POST /{WABA_ID}/message_templates with each object below.
_readme.after_approval: They appear in Admin > Automations > Templates within 5 minutes (the list is cached that long). The automation refuses to save a step naming an unapproved template, so nothing can go out early.

templates.name: op_recovery_offer_v1
templates._used_at: Day 2 — the offer. Carries NO code: the patient claims it, which is what makes the claim a signal and keeps this template free of a per-patient code.

components.text:
Hi {{1}}, thank you for visiting Sobhana Diagnostics.

If your doctor has suggested any tests, you can get *50% off* your next diagnostic visit.

Tap below and we will send you your discount code.
Reply STOP to stop these messages

templates.name: op_recovery_code_v1
templates._used_at: Sent the moment they tap. Also reused for a late claim on Day 5 — the code and its date are the same either way.

components.text:
Your 50% off code is ready.

Show this at any Sobhana branch on your next diagnostic visit. One-time use, and it covers the whole bill for your tests.

templates.name: op_recovery_expiring_code_v1
templates._used_at: Day 5, to someone already holding a code. Says USE it, because they have one.

components.text:
Your 50% off code expires tomorrow.

*{{1}}*

Show this at any Sobhana branch before it runs out. One-time use, and it covers the whole bill for your tests.

templates.name: op_recovery_expiring_claim_v1
templates._used_at: Day 5, to someone who never claimed. Says CLAIM it, because they have nothing yet. Same day, two different truths — which is why the journey branches here rather than sending one message that is wrong for half the people.
